single_opml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<opml version="2.0">
  <head>
    <ownerEmail>
      user@example.com
    </ownerEmail>
  </head>
  <body>
    <outline text="Export fixture" _note="Root note line">
      <outline text="<b>Bold</b> and <i>italic</i> & <u>under</u> #tag" _note="child note">
        <outline text="Grandchild A" />
        <outline text="Grandchild <code>code</code>" />
      </outline>
      <outline text="Second <a href="https://example.com">link</a> "quoted" &lt;x&gt;" />
      <outline text="Todo list">
        <outline text="Task one" />
        <outline _complete="true" text="Task two" />
      </outline>
      <outline text="Heading one" />
      <outline text="<hr />" />
      <outline text="Quote" />
      <outline text="1. Numbered A" />
      <outline text="2. Numbered B" />
      <outline _complete="true" text="Done plain" />
    </outline>
  </body>
</opml>
